# ThinkRail components

The written reference of the component library. The live library renders the same content with the production components, styles and themes: `bun run library:dev`, or `bun run library:build` for the static site.

## Using the library

This library renders ThinkRail's production components from source with the app's own stylesheet, tokens and themes. When a component changes, its page changes with it. The written guidance here is also published as `packages/ui/COMPONENTS.md` for agents and reviews.

### Rules

Follow these before writing any UI, and cite the IDs in reviews.

- **LIB-1** — **Search and reuse first.** Look for an existing component and its supported variants in this library, `packages/ui/*.tsx`, `apps/web/src/components` and the owning feature module, and check how real call sites use it.
- **LIB-2** — **Compose or extend before adding.** Combine existing components, or extend one when its behaviour and semantic contract stay the same. Add a component only when the system cannot express the need.
- **LIB-3** — **Choose by contract, not by look.** Buttons, switches, tabs, menu items, tree rows and disclosures behave differently for keyboards and assistive technology. Never restyle one into another.
- **LIB-4** — **Use supported props; never recreate appearance.** A component owns its geometry, colour, typography and states. A call site passes props and adds placement only — no copied skins, no state classes, no colour or type overrides.
- **LIB-5** — **A new component ships with its documentation.** Compare it with the nearest existing components (behaviour, API, styling), record what you adopted and rejected, place it at the right level — shared primitive in `packages/ui`, app composite in `apps/web/src/components`, or local to its feature — and add its page, live examples and checks to this library in the same change.

### Where values live

The library explains usage; it never restates values. Implementation values stay in production code and the token sources: the component source (`packages/ui/<name>.tsx`) and its spec (`packages/ui/SPEC.md`), colour roles (`apps/web/src/styles/COLOR.md`), typography (`TYPOGRAPHY.md`) and spacing (`SPACING.md`). A missing token is added at its source and validated there, never at a call site.

### Examples

Every example is a real component rendered from source with mocked data and real interactions — hover, press, Tab, click. Copy the code as a starting point; labels use locale keys, as the app requires.

### Adding a component page

Write its guidance in `apps/web/library/content/<name>.ts` and its examples in `apps/web/library/examples/<name>/`, register it in `content/index.ts`, then run `bun run library:md` to regenerate the Markdown reference. `library.test.ts` fails when the reference is stale, an example file is missing, or a listed production usage no longer uses the component.

### Commands

`bun run library:dev` starts the library with hot reload. `bun run library:build` checks the Markdown reference, typechecks and writes the static site to `apps/web/dist-library/`. `bun run library:md` regenerates `packages/ui/COMPONENTS.md`.

## Button

The one action button for text actions, with optional leading and trailing icons. It owns its geometry, colour, typography and every interaction state; call sites choose a variant and size and add only placement.

```tsx
import { Button } from "@thinkrail/ui/button";
```

### When to use

- Any ordinary action with a visible label: submit, confirm, cancel, open, retry.
- A text toggle that stays on, with `selected` and `aria-pressed`.
- A link that must look like a button: put `buttonVariants(...)` on the `<a>`, do not nest a button in a link.

### Alternatives

| Instead | When |
| --- | --- |
| IconButton | The action is fully clear from a familiar icon and space is tight. It needs a `label`. |
| Switch | An on/off setting that applies immediately (`role="switch"`). |
| ToggleSegment | Choosing one view among a small set in a header strip. |
| Menu item | An action inside a dropdown or context menu (`menuItemClass` rows). |
| Text link | Navigation inside prose or metadata. |

### Anatomy

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Container | The `<button>` with the variant's fill, a 1px border slot and the size's height and padding. |
| Leading icon | `iconLeft`, sized by the button; replaced by the spinner while loading. |
| Label | The children; one line, never wraps. |
| Trailing icon | `iconRight`, sized by the button. |
| Focus ring | A 2px `primary` outline offset by 2px, shown for keyboard focus only. |
| Tooltip | Optional `tooltip`, rendered by the shared IconTooltip. |

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `"primary" \| "soft-primary" \| "outline" \| "ghost" \| "destructive"` | `"primary"` | The action's role. Pick it by meaning, not by the colour you want. |
| `size` | `"s" \| "m" \| "l"` | `"l"` | Height, padding, gap and icon size together. Values live in `packages/ui/SPEC.md` *Sizes*. |
| `tone` | `"warning" \| "danger"` | — | Keeps the feedback colour on the label in every state. Applies to `ghost` and `outline`; other variants ignore it. |
| `selected` | `boolean` | `false` | Persistent toggle or open state. Styled on `outline`, `ghost` and `soft-primary`. An open Radix trigger (`data-state="open"`) shows it automatically. Pair a toggle with `aria-pressed`. |
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows an icon-sized spinner without changing geometry, sets `aria-busy` and natively disables the button so the action cannot run twice. |
| `spinIcon` | `boolean` | `false` | With `loading`, rotates the button's own icon in place instead of swapping in the spinner — for a refresh whose content stays valid. |
| `tooltip` | `ReactNode` | — | An explanation shown through the shared tooltip, also while disabled. Replaces the native `title`, which the button does not accept. |
| `tooltipSide` | `"top" \| "right" \| "bottom" \| "left"` | — | Preferred tooltip side. |
| `tooltipAlign` | `"start" \| "center" \| "end"` | — | Tooltip alignment along that side. |
| `wrapTrigger` | `boolean` | — | Wraps the tooltip trigger in a span. Automatic while `disabled`; set `true` to keep the span permanently or to isolate a second Radix trigger, `false` to opt out. |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLButtonElement>` | — | Forwarded to the `<button>` element (React 19 ref prop). |
| `iconLeft` | `ButtonIcon` | — | Leading icon component (pass `RiAddLine`, not `<RiAddLine />`). The button sizes it. |
| `iconRight` | `ButtonIcon` | — | Trailing icon component, usually a chevron. |

Native button props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | — | The label. Use a locale key: `{t("…")}`. |
| `type` | `"button" \| "submit" \| "reset"` | `"button"` | Native button type. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | — | Keeps the button in place on the disabled roles (never hidden, never opacity) and blocks pointer and keyboard activation. |
| `onClick` | `MouseEventHandler` | — | Activation handler (pointer, Enter, Space). |
| `className` | `string` | — | Placement only: margins, flex/grid placement, `w-full`, positioning, responsive visibility. |

### Variants

| Variant | Use it for |
| --- | --- |
| `primary` | The main action of a surface — Save, Create, Send. Accent fill. Use at most one per decision. |
| `soft-primary` | An accent action that should not compete with the main one — Sign in, Show in panel, an update affordance. Accent tint and accent label. |
| `outline` | A neutral, clearly bounded action — Cancel beside a primary, API key, Not now. The default secondary action. |
| `ghost` | A quiet action with no surface of its own — toolbar, header and row actions, Dismiss. Muted label with a neutral hover fill. |
| `destructive` | Confirms an irreversible action — Delete, Discard. Danger fill. Ask first; use it on the confirming step. |

### Sizes

| Size | Use it for |
| --- | --- |
| `s` | Dense rows, inline chips and comment cards, where the button sits inside a line of content. |
| `m` | Panel headers, toolbars, popovers and secondary actions in settings rows. |
| `l` | The default for Button — dialog footers, empty states and standalone actions. |

### Tone

`tone` applies to `outline` and `ghost`; other variants ignore it.

| Tone | Use it for |
| --- | --- |
| `warning` | A ghost or outline action whose label must read as a warning in every state (a pending MCP approval). |
| `danger` | A ghost or outline action whose label must read as dangerous in every state without a danger fill (Stop all). |

### States

| State | How | Appearance |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Default | Rest. | The variant's fill, border and label colour. |
| Hover | Pointer over the button. | The variant's hover role; geometry never moves. |
| Pressed | Pointer down or Space held. | Identical to hover. |
| Keyboard focus | Tab to the button. | 2px `primary` outline with a 2px offset; `ghost` also takes its hover fill. |
| Disabled | `disabled`. | Disabled roles, cursor and activation blocked, tooltip still shown. |
| Loading | `loading` (optionally `spinIcon`). | Spinner at icon size, same width, `aria-busy`, not activatable. |
| Selected | `selected` or an open Radix trigger. | Selected fill on `outline` / `ghost`; hover look on `soft-primary`; none on `primary` / `destructive`. |

### Accessibility

- Renders a native `<button type="button">`, so role, focus and activation come from the platform.
- The label is the accessible name; keep it short and specific. Icons are `aria-hidden`.
- Never use `title`; explain with `tooltip`, which also reaches keyboard users and disabled buttons.
- A toggle sets `aria-pressed`; a disclosure sets `aria-expanded`; a menu trigger gets its ARIA from Radix.
- Loading sets `aria-busy` and disables the button; keep the label so the name does not change.
- The tooltip opens on hover and keyboard focus, not on programmatic focus, and one Escape closes it together with the layer beneath.

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `Tab / Shift+Tab` | Moves focus to and from the button; the focus ring appears. |
| `Enter / Space` | Activates. Space shows the pressed state while held. |
| `Escape` | Closes an open tooltip (and a dialog or menu beneath it). |

### Usage rules

- **BTN-1** — Choose the variant by the action's role. One `primary` per decision; `destructive` only on the confirming step.
- **BTN-2** — Pass props, never classes, for appearance. No height, padding, colour, border, radius or typography at the call site.
- **BTN-3** — Warning or danger emphasis on a quiet action is `tone`, never a colour class.
- **BTN-4** — Use `loading` for in-flight actions instead of a hand-made spinner; `spinIcon` for a refresh whose content stays valid.
- **BTN-5** — Explain a disabled or unclear action with `tooltip`; never with `title`.
- **BTN-6** — Labels come from locale keys and stay on one line; give the button room or `w-full` instead of wrapping.

### Examples

#### Dialog actions

A neutral dismiss beside the main action.

```tsx
import { useT } from "@thinkrail/locales/react";
import { Button } from "@thinkrail/ui/button";

export default function DialogActions() {
	const t = useT();
	return (
		<div className="flex justify-end gap-8">
			<Button variant="outline" onClick={() => {}}>
				{t("common.cancel")}
			</Button>
			<Button onClick={() => {}}>{t("common.save")}</Button>
		</div>
	);
}
```

#### Icons

Leading, trailing and both icons. The button sizes them.

```tsx
import { RiAddLine, RiArrowDownSLine, RiArrowRightLine } from "@remixicon/react";
import { useT } from "@thinkrail/locales/react";
import { Button } from "@thinkrail/ui/button";

export default function Icons() {
	const t = useT();
	return (
		<div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-8">
			<Button variant="outline" iconLeft={RiAddLine}>
				{t("common.add")}
			</Button>
			<Button variant="outline" iconRight={RiArrowRightLine}>
				{t("common.next")}
			</Button>
			<Button variant="outline" iconLeft={RiAddLine} iconRight={RiArrowDownSLine}>
				{t("common.add")}
			</Button>
		</div>
	);
}
```

#### Variants

Every variant at the default size.

```tsx
import { useT } from "@thinkrail/locales/react";
import { Button } from "@thinkrail/ui/button";

export default function Variants() {
	const t = useT();
	return (
		<div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-8">
			<Button variant="primary">{t("common.save")}</Button>
			<Button variant="soft-primary">{t("common.confirm")}</Button>
			<Button variant="outline">{t("common.cancel")}</Button>
			<Button variant="ghost">{t("common.dismiss")}</Button>
			<Button variant="destructive">{t("common.delete")}</Button>
		</div>
	);
}
```

#### Sizes

S, M and L in one variant.

```tsx
import { RiAddLine } from "@remixicon/react";
import { useT } from "@thinkrail/locales/react";
import { Button } from "@thinkrail/ui/button";

export default function Sizes() {
	const t = useT();
	return (
		<div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-8">
			<Button variant="outline" size="s" iconLeft={RiAddLine}>
				{t("common.add")}
			</Button>
			<Button variant="outline" size="m" iconLeft={RiAddLine}>
				{t("common.add")}
			</Button>
			<Button variant="outline" size="l" iconLeft={RiAddLine}>
				{t("common.add")}
			</Button>
		</div>
	);
}
```

#### Loading

A real async action: the spinner keeps the width and blocks a second click.

```tsx
import { RiSave3Line } from "@remixicon/react";
import { useT } from "@thinkrail/locales/react";
import { Button } from "@thinkrail/ui/button";
import { useState } from "react";

export default function Loading() {
	const t = useT();
	const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
	const [saves, setSaves] = useState(0);
	const save = () => {
		setSaving(true);
		setSaves((count) => count + 1);
		setTimeout(() => setSaving(false), 1500);
	};
	return (
		<div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-8">
			<Button iconLeft={RiSave3Line} loading={saving} onClick={save}>
				{t("common.save")}
			</Button>
			<Button variant="outline" loading={saving} onClick={save}>
				{t("common.save")}
			</Button>
			<output className="tr-text-metadata text-text-muted">{saves}</output>
		</div>
	);
}
```

#### Refresh in place

`loading` with `spinIcon` rotates the button's own icon.

```tsx
import { RiRefreshLine } from "@remixicon/react";
import { useT } from "@thinkrail/locales/react";
import { Button } from "@thinkrail/ui/button";
import { useState } from "react";

export default function Refresh() {
	const t = useT();
	const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
	return (
		<Button
			variant="ghost"
			size="m"
			iconLeft={RiRefreshLine}
			loading={refreshing}
			spinIcon
			onClick={() => {
				setRefreshing(true);
				setTimeout(() => setRefreshing(false), 1500);
			}}
		>
			{t("chat.modelPicker.refresh")}
		</Button>
	);
}
```

#### Selected toggle

A persistent on/off text toggle with `aria-pressed`.

```tsx
import { useT } from "@thinkrail/locales/react";
import { Button } from "@thinkrail/ui/button";
import { useState } from "react";

export default function Toggle() {
	const t = useT();
	const [hidden, setHidden] = useState(false);
	return (
		<Button
			variant="outline"
			size="m"
			selected={hidden}
			aria-pressed={hidden}
			onClick={() => setHidden((value) => !value)}
		>
			{t("panels.diffPane.hideWhitespace")}
		</Button>
	);
}
```

#### Disabled with a reason

The tooltip still explains why while the button is disabled.

```tsx
import { useT } from "@thinkrail/locales/react";
import { Button } from "@thinkrail/ui/button";

export default function DisabledReason() {
	const t = useT();
	return (
		<Button size="m" disabled tooltip={t("plan.item.reviewBusy")}>
			{t("plan.item.checkIt")}
		</Button>
	);
}
```

#### Tone

Warning and danger labels on quiet actions.

```tsx
import { RiDeleteBinLine, RiErrorWarningLine, RiStopLine } from "@remixicon/react";
import { useT } from "@thinkrail/locales/react";
import { Button } from "@thinkrail/ui/button";

export default function Tone() {
	const t = useT();
	return (
		<div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-8">
			<Button variant="ghost" size="m" tone="danger" iconLeft={RiStopLine}>
				{t("resources.inspector.stopAll")}
			</Button>
			<Button variant="outline" size="m" tone="danger" iconLeft={RiDeleteBinLine}>
				{t("common.delete")}
			</Button>
			<Button variant="ghost" size="m" tone="warning" iconLeft={RiErrorWarningLine}>
				{t("lib.mcpState.pendingApproval")}
			</Button>
		</div>
	);
}
```

#### Long label

Labels never wrap: the button grows to its label, or fills a column with `w-full`. Keep the column wider than the label; a label that does not fit is shortened, not wrapped.

```tsx
import { RiGitCommitLine } from "@remixicon/react";
import { useT } from "@thinkrail/locales/react";
import { Button } from "@thinkrail/ui/button";

export default function LongLabel() {
	const t = useT();
	return (
		<div className="flex flex-col items-start gap-8">
			<Button variant="outline" size="m" iconLeft={RiGitCommitLine}>
				{t("plan.revisions.openCommit")}
			</Button>
			<div className="w-full max-w-[26rem]">
				<Button variant="primary" className="w-full">
					{t("plan.revisions.openCommit")}
				</Button>
			</div>
		</div>
	);
}
```

#### Link styled as a button

`buttonVariants` on an `<a>` for navigation.

```tsx
import { useT } from "@thinkrail/locales/react";
import { buttonDataAttributes, buttonVariants } from "@thinkrail/ui/button";

export default function Link() {
	const t = useT();
	return (
		<a
			href="#/icon-button"
			{...buttonDataAttributes({ variant: "outline", size: "m" })}
			className={buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "m" })}
		>
			{t("common.next")}
		</a>
	);
}
```

### In production

| File | What it shows |
| --- | --- |
| `apps/web/src/panels/ConfirmDialog.tsx` | Cancel (outline) and the destructive or primary confirmation. |
| `apps/web/src/panels/ProvidersSettings.tsx` | Sign in / Sign out (soft-primary), API key (outline), refresh with `spinIcon`. |

| `apps/web/src/panels/PlanPane.tsx` | Open PR with `loading`, plan header actions. |

The full technical contract is `packages/ui/SPEC.md`.

## IconButton

A square, icon-only action. Its required `label` is both the accessible name and the shared tooltip, so an icon is never left unexplained. Same variants, sizes and states as Button; defaults to `ghost` at `m`.

```tsx
import { IconButton } from "@thinkrail/ui/button";
```

### When to use

- Toolbar, header, tab and row actions where a familiar icon is clear: close, copy, more, add, refresh.
- Compact toggles in a header strip, with `selected` and `aria-pressed`.
- A menu trigger (`DropdownMenuTrigger asChild`), which shows the selected state while the menu is open.

### Alternatives

| Instead | When |
| --- | --- |
| Button | The action needs words to be understood, or it is the main action of a surface. |
| Button with iconLeft | An icon helps recognition but the label must stay visible. |
| ToggleSegment | Switching between a few named views. |

### Anatomy

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Container | A square of the size's height; no text padding. |
| Icon | `icon`, sized by the button; replaced by the spinner while loading. |
| Focus ring | A 2px `primary` outline; on `ghost` it sits 2px inside so clipped header strips keep it. |
| Tooltip | Always present: `tooltip` if given, otherwise the `label`. |

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `icon` | `ButtonIcon` | — | The icon component (pass `RiCloseLine`, not `<RiCloseLine />`). Line by default, Fill for an active state. |
| `label` | `string` | — | Required. The accessible name (`aria-label`) and the default tooltip text. Use a locale key. |
| `variant` | `"primary" \| "soft-primary" \| "outline" \| "ghost" \| "destructive"` | `"ghost"` | The action's role. Pick it by meaning, not by the colour you want. |
| `size` | `"s" \| "m" \| "l"` | `"m"` | Height, padding, gap and icon size together. Values live in `packages/ui/SPEC.md` *Sizes*. |
| `tone` | `"warning" \| "danger"` | — | Keeps the feedback colour on the label in every state. Applies to `ghost` and `outline`; other variants ignore it. |
| `selected` | `boolean` | `false` | Persistent toggle or open state. Styled on `outline`, `ghost` and `soft-primary`. An open Radix trigger (`data-state="open"`) shows it automatically. Pair a toggle with `aria-pressed`. |
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows an icon-sized spinner without changing geometry, sets `aria-busy` and natively disables the button so the action cannot run twice. |
| `spinIcon` | `boolean` | `false` | With `loading`, rotates the button's own icon in place instead of swapping in the spinner — for a refresh whose content stays valid. |
| `tooltip` | `ReactNode` | — | Overrides the tooltip text (for example to add a shortcut) while `label` stays the accessible name. |
| `tooltipSide` | `"top" \| "right" \| "bottom" \| "left"` | — | Preferred tooltip side. |
| `tooltipAlign` | `"start" \| "center" \| "end"` | — | Tooltip alignment along that side. |
| `wrapTrigger` | `boolean` | — | Wraps the tooltip trigger in a span. Automatic while `disabled`; set `true` to keep the span permanently or to isolate a second Radix trigger, `false` to opt out. |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLButtonElement>` | — | Forwarded to the `<button>` element (React 19 ref prop). |

Native button props:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `"button" \| "submit" \| "reset"` | `"button"` | Native button type. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | — | Disabled roles; the tooltip still opens on hover so the reason stays readable. |
| `onClick` | `MouseEventHandler` | — | Activation handler (pointer, Enter, Space). |
| `className` | `string` | — | Placement only, including whole-button hover reveal (`opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100`). |

### Variants

| Variant | Use it for |
| --- | --- |
| `primary` | The main action of a surface — Save, Create, Send. Accent fill. Use at most one per decision. |
| `soft-primary` | An accent action that should not compete with the main one — Sign in, Show in panel, an update affordance. Accent tint and accent label. |
| `outline` | A neutral, clearly bounded action — Cancel beside a primary, API key, Not now. The default secondary action. |
| `ghost` | A quiet action with no surface of its own — toolbar, header and row actions, Dismiss. Muted label with a neutral hover fill. |
| `destructive` | Confirms an irreversible action — Delete, Discard. Danger fill. Ask first; use it on the confirming step. |

### Sizes

| Size | Use it for |
| --- | --- |
| `s` | Dense rows, inline chips and comment cards, where the button sits inside a line of content. |
| `m` | The default for IconButton — panel headers, tab strips, toolbars and toasts. |
| `l` | Standalone icon actions next to L buttons. |

### Tone

`tone` applies to `outline` and `ghost`; other variants ignore it.

| Tone | Use it for |
| --- | --- |
| `warning` | A ghost or outline action whose label must read as a warning in every state (a pending MCP approval). |
| `danger` | A ghost or outline action whose label must read as dangerous in every state without a danger fill (Stop all). |

### States

| State | How | Appearance |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Default | Rest. | The variant's fill; `ghost` shows only the muted icon. |
| Hover | Pointer over the button. | The variant's hover role; the tooltip opens after the shared delay. |
| Pressed | Pointer down or Space held. | Identical to hover. |
| Keyboard focus | Tab to the button. | Focus ring and the tooltip. |
| Disabled | `disabled`. | Disabled roles; tooltip still opens on hover. |
| Loading | `loading` (optionally `spinIcon`). | Spinner or rotating icon, same square, `aria-busy`. |
| Selected | `selected` or an open Radix trigger. | Selected fill on `outline` / `ghost`. |

### Accessibility

- `label` is mandatory and becomes `aria-label`; the icon is `aria-hidden`.
- The tooltip repeats the label for sighted pointer and keyboard users; `tooltip` may add detail but never replaces the name.
- A toggle sets `aria-pressed`; a disclosure sets `aria-expanded`.
- Keep icons conventional; when a reader could misread the icon, use a Button with a label instead.

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `Tab / Shift+Tab` | Moves focus; the focus ring and the tooltip appear. |
| `Enter / Space` | Activates. Space shows the pressed state while held. |
| `Escape` | Closes the tooltip (and a dialog or menu beneath it). |

### Usage rules

- **ICB-1** — Every icon-only action is an IconButton with a `label` from a locale key — never a raw `<button>` with an icon.
- **ICB-2** — Do not add `title` or a hand-rolled tooltip wrapper; use `tooltip` to extend the text.
- **ICB-3** — Use `ghost` for chrome actions; reserve filled variants for an icon action that is the main action.
- **ICB-4** — Use `selected` with `aria-pressed` for persistent toggles; never fake an on state with classes.

### Examples

#### Basic

The label is the accessible name and the tooltip.

```tsx
import { RiCloseLine, RiFileCopyLine, RiPencilLine } from "@remixicon/react";
import { useT } from "@thinkrail/locales/react";
import { IconButton } from "@thinkrail/ui/button";

export default function Basic() {
	const t = useT();
	return (
		<div className="flex items-center gap-4">
			<IconButton icon={RiPencilLine} label={t("common.edit")} onClick={() => {}} />
			<IconButton icon={RiFileCopyLine} label={t("common.copy")} onClick={() => {}} />
			<IconButton icon={RiCloseLine} label={t("common.close")} onClick={() => {}} />
		</div>
	);
}
```

#### Sizes

S, M (default) and L.

```tsx
import { RiAddLine } from "@remixicon/react";
import { useT } from "@thinkrail/locales/react";
import { IconButton } from "@thinkrail/ui/button";

export default function Sizes() {
	const t = useT();
	return (
		<div className="flex items-center gap-8">
			<IconButton variant="outline" size="s" icon={RiAddLine} label={t("common.add")} />
			<IconButton variant="outline" size="m" icon={RiAddLine} label={t("common.add")} />
			<IconButton variant="outline" size="l" icon={RiAddLine} label={t("common.add")} />
		</div>
	);
}
```

			<IconButton variant="destructive" icon={RiDeleteBinLine} label={t("common.delete")} />

}

#### Toggle

A header toggle with `selected` and `aria-pressed`.

```tsx
import { RiParagraph } from "@remixicon/react";
import { useT } from "@thinkrail/locales/react";
import { IconButton } from "@thinkrail/ui/button";
import { useState } from "react";

export default function Toggle() {
	const t = useT();
	const [hidden, setHidden] = useState(false);
	return (
		<IconButton
			icon={RiParagraph}
			label={t("panels.diffPane.hideWhitespace")}
			selected={hidden}
			aria-pressed={hidden}
			onClick={() => setHidden((value) => !value)}
		/>
	);
}
```

#### Menu trigger

Inside `DropdownMenuTrigger asChild`; selected while open.

#### Loading and refresh

Spinner, and `spinIcon` rotating the icon in place.

```tsx
import { RiRefreshLine, RiSendPlaneLine } from "@remixicon/react";
import { useT } from "@thinkrail/locales/react";
import { IconButton } from "@thinkrail/ui/button";
import { useState } from "react";

export default function Loading() {
	const t = useT();
	const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);
	const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
	const run = (set: (value: boolean) => void) => {
		set(true);
		setTimeout(() => set(false), 1500);
	};
	return (
		<div className="flex items-center gap-8">
			<IconButton
				variant="primary"
				icon={RiSendPlaneLine}
				label={t("common.confirm")}
				loading={sending}
				onClick={() => run(setSending)}
			/>
			<IconButton
				icon={RiRefreshLine}
				label={t("panels.branchPicker.refresh")}
				loading={refreshing}
				spinIcon
				onClick={() => run(setRefreshing)}
			/>
		</div>
	);
}
```

#### Tone

Danger and warning icon actions.

```tsx
import { RiDeleteBinLine, RiErrorWarningLine, RiStopLine } from "@remixicon/react";
import { useT } from "@thinkrail/locales/react";
import { IconButton } from "@thinkrail/ui/button";

export default function Tone() {
	const t = useT();
	return (
		<div className="flex items-center gap-8">
			<IconButton tone="danger" icon={RiStopLine} label={t("resources.inspector.stopAll")} />
			<IconButton tone="danger" icon={RiDeleteBinLine} label={t("common.delete")} />
			<IconButton
				tone="warning"
				icon={RiErrorWarningLine}
				label={t("components.attentionDot.label")}
			/>
		</div>
	);
}
```

### In production

| File | What it shows |
| --- | --- |
| `packages/ui/dialog.tsx` | Every dialog's Close button (ghost, m). |
| `packages/ui/toast.tsx` | `ToastClose`. |
| `apps/web/src/panels/HeaderIconButton.tsx` | Panel header toggles with `selected` and `aria-pressed`. |
| `apps/web/src/shell/layout/workbenchTabs.tsx` | Tab close and the open-tabs search trigger. |
| `apps/web/src/chat/CopyButton.tsx` | Message copy action at size S, revealed on hover. |

The full technical contract is `packages/ui/SPEC.md`.
